steps.name: Web level first
steps.goal: Wait for the 'My web level app' card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The card shows the web preview inline, with icon tabs for Web and Your phone under it and a full screen button.

steps.name: Full screen stays in the app
steps.goal: Tap Full screen web preview once.
steps.done: The preview opens in the app with a Close web preview button.

steps.name: Close full screen
steps.done: The original card with Web and Your phone tabs is visible again.

steps.name: Switch to Your phone
steps.goal: Tap the 'Your phone' tab under the preview once.
steps.done: The card shows three short steps: get Expo Go, sign in as the Expo account, and open in Expo Go.

steps.name: Anonymous preview fails closed
steps.goal: Scroll down to the Owner auth preview card. Inspect its web preview. Do not sign in.
steps.done: The anonymous owner preview shows the recoverable sign-in failure.
expect: Preview sign-in failed. Reload the preview to try again.
